args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api:
   - Current production version: **v2.3.1** — unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
   - Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy, but older).

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the rollback to v2.3.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
